I am farming here in Dodoma where the rains are not reliable, so I must be careful with money. I own this plot, which is good, but chemical fertilizer is expensive and I cannot afford much — I will put a little on the maize if I can find some, but mostly I rely on the manure from my few goats and cattle. I use the seeds I saved from last year because hybrid seed costs too much and I do not trust the rains enough to risk it. My wife and children will help me in the field, and during planting and weeding I will call on one or two neighbors to help for a few days.
